\section[(dialogue)]{School, clothes and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R149-first-pass-school-clothes-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for spicy and fresh.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a shore, an island, lightning; electricity, a storm, a crow
  \item a sparrow, a parrot, a pigeon, an owl, a frog
  \item a tortoise, a crocodile, a deer, a rabbit, a wolf
  \item a fox, a donkey, an ox, a mosquito, the forehead
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A shore? (\textbf{\mr{किनारा}}, \emph{kinārā}.) An island? (\textbf{\mr{बेट}}, \emph{beṭ}.) Lightning; electricity? (\textbf{\mr{वीज}}, \emph{vīj}.) A storm? (\textbf{\mr{वादळ}}, \emph{vādaḷ}.) A crow? (\textbf{\mr{कावळा}}, \emph{kāvḷā}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\mr{चिमणी}}, \emph{cimṇī}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\mr{पोपट}}, \emph{popaṭ}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\mr{कबूतर}}, \emph{kabūtar}.) An owl? (\textbf{\mr{घुबड}}, \emph{ghubaḍ}.) A frog? (\textbf{\mr{बेडूक}}, \emph{beḍūk}.) A tortoise? (\textbf{\mr{कासव}}, \emph{kāsav}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\mr{मगर}}, \emph{magar}.) A deer? (\textbf{\mr{हरीण}}, \emph{harīṇ}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\mr{ससा}}, \emph{sasā}.) A wolf? (\textbf{\mr{लांडगा}}, \emph{lāṇḍgā}.) A fox? (\textbf{\mr{कोल्हा}}, \emph{kolhā}.) A donkey? (\textbf{\mr{गाढव}}, \emph{gāḍhav}.) An ox? (\textbf{\mr{बैल}}, \emph{bail}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\mr{डास}}, \emph{ḍās}.) The forehead? (\textbf{\mr{कपाळ}}, \emph{kapāḷ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Food and nature — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R149-second-pass-food-and-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a cheek and the tongue.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a cheek, the tongue, the chin, an elbow, a wrist
  \item a thumb, a fingernail, the back, the waist, the chest
  \item the skin, a bone, wide, narrow, thin
  \item heavy, soft, hard, lukewarm, dry
  \item salty, sour, bitter, spicy, fresh
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A cheek? (\textbf{\mr{गाल}}, \emph{gāl}.) The tongue? (\textbf{\mr{जीभ}}, \emph{jībh}.) The chin? (\textbf{\mr{हनुवटी}}, \emph{hanuvaṭī}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\mr{कोपर}}, \emph{kopar}.) A wrist? (\textbf{\mr{मनगट}}, \emph{managaṭ}.) A thumb? (\textbf{\mr{अंगठा}}, \emph{aṅgṭhā}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\mr{नख}}, \emph{nakh}.) The back? (\textbf{\mr{पाठ}}, \emph{pāṭh}.) The waist? (\textbf{\mr{कंबर}}, \emph{kambar}.) The chest? (\textbf{\mr{छाती}}, \emph{chātī}.) The skin? (\textbf{\mr{त्वचा}}, \emph{tvacā}.) A bone? (\textbf{\mr{हाड}}, \emph{hāḍ}.) Wide? (\textbf{\mr{रुंद}}, \emph{ruṇd}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\mr{अरुंद}}, \emph{aruṇd}.) Thin? (\textbf{\mr{पातळ}}, \emph{pātaḷ}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\mr{जड}}, \emph{jaḍ}.) Soft? (\textbf{\mr{मऊ}}, \emph{maū}.) Hard? (\textbf{\mr{कडक}}, \emph{kaḍak}.) Lukewarm? (\textbf{\mr{कोमट}}, \emph{komaṭ}.) Dry? (\textbf{\mr{सुका}}, \emph{sukā}.) Salty? (\textbf{\mr{खारट}}, \emph{khāraṭ}.) Sour? (\textbf{\mr{आंबट}}, \emph{āmbaṭ}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\mr{कडू}}, \emph{kaḍū}.) Spicy? (\textbf{\mr{तिखट}}, \emph{tikhaṭ}.) Fresh? (\textbf{\mr{ताजा}}, \emph{tājā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
